Date: July 30, 2025
Ticker: ACME
Q3 Fiscal Year 2025

Operator: Good afternoon. A question-and-answer session will follow the prepared remarks.
Rita Voss: Welcome to the Acme Robotics second quarter call. Statements today include forward-looking statements and safe harbor language.
Daniel Okafor: Revenue reached $4,550,000,000, in line with guidance. Servo motor supply has normalized after we added a second vendor.
Our new Hermes conveyor product line launched in June and contributed early orders from retail customers.
Priya Raman: Gross margin was 51 percent. We guide third quarter revenue to $4.8 billion. Tariff costs are a modest headwind.
Operator: We will now take our first question. Our first question comes from Marcus Lee with Northbridge Securities.
Marcus Lee: Has the tariff impact changed your outlook on margins?
Priya Raman: Tariffs cost roughly one point of margin. We are mitigating through sourcing changes.
Operator: Our next question comes from Elena Park with Harbor Capital.
Elena Park:
Daniel Okafor: Hermes demand is early but encouraging.
